**Sweden: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 1,068,354 applications. The largest annual volume was 173,786 in 2015; 2025 recorded 14,072. Applications in 2025 were 61% lower than in 2019 (36,024). In 2025, 16,924 recorded decisions equated to 120 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 18% lower than in 2024 (17,095). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 1 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Iran (Islamic Rep. of) (1,357), Afghanistan (1,191), Syrian Arab Rep. (1,082).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 21%, across 13,942 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 18% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 1.2 percentage points lower than in 2024 (23%).
